rows.heading: Time-Bound Promotion Channel (E1→E4)
rows.quote_snippet: (c) Promotion from E3 to E4: 3 to 4 (three to four) completed years of qualifying residency service at Grade E3.

rows.heading: APAR Benchmark for Time-Bound Promotion
rows.quote_snippet: (c) For E3→E4: Minimum cumulative rating of 'Very Good' (score ≥ 3.5 / 70%) across the preceding residency period.

rows.heading: APAR Benchmark for Time-Bound Promotion
rows.quote_snippet: 3.2 Adverse Remark Disqualification: Any uncommunicated or sustained adverse remark, or an APAR rating below 'Good' in any single year, shall result in deferment of promotion by one year until the benchmark is restored.
